data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Achi Takagama. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 private companies and 2 public entities operating in defense technology, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and others in adjacent stages.

The peer-median method serves as the primary valuation anchor. Three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE (seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M)—yielded a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This method is applicable given sufficient peer density and stage alignment, though the wide dispersion (8x spread) reflects heterogeneity in capital deployment and growth profiles within early-stage defense tech.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered at $400M. Key uncertainties include the limited number of contemporaneous comparable transactions, the heterogeneity of business models and technology maturity within the peer set, and the absence of revenue or technical performance benchmarks in the available data. The wide range between low and high estimates ($120M spread) underscores sensitivity to peer selection and the early-stage nature of valuation precision. Absent additional disclosure on capital raised or financial metrics, this range should be treated as illustrative pending deeper operational due diligence.
